# superset_tag (Data Source)

Looks up a tag by its name, for example to reference its id or to check that it exists. Tag names are unique; the lookup fails when no tag has exactly that name. The tag API needs the `TAGGING_SYSTEM` feature flag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_tag" "finance" {
  name = "finance"
}

output "finance_tag_id" {
  value = data.superset_tag.finance.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tag. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the tag.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the tag.
